edits.text: Hypothesis: young adults may see tea as a home drink, not a summer choice. They may never think of it when wanting something cold and fizzy. Fernley should take tea from the kitchen table into the Irish summer, cold and sparkling.

The objection it must beat: This insight rests on no research. We should not believe it yet. It is a testable hypothesis; we propose quick audience interviews to confirm or replace it before creative development.
